*Ss. 10(5), 10(6) : S. 10(5) repugnant to the Constitution insofar as it contains the words "punish the offender in like manner as if he had been guilty of contempt of Court." Consequent upon which the words "without prejudice to its powers under subsection (5), the court may, after a hearing under that subsection," should be deleted from S. 10(6): see Desmond and Dedier v Glackin (No. 2) [1993] I.R. 67.
